proposed_rules.trigger: A two-column 'Traditional Solutions vs Knack' comparison with a header row and N aligned [2x1] rows contrasting a pain point against Knack's answer, followed by a CTA.
proposed_rules.decision: Emit ONE 'comparison-table' block with one row per pain-point pair (header row + N rows), and the trailing CTA as default-content/CTA link in the same section.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternatives: (a) a plain HTML table via default-content markdown table syntax -- loses the ability to style two distinct visual columns differently; (b) two separate 'cards' blocks (one per column) -- breaks the row-wise pairing that gives the comparison its meaning. A dedicated block preserves the paired-row semantics while staying table-per-item.
